name: Dangerous Rescue
html: : You may KO a card from your hand or discard pile. If you do, rescue a Bystander.
method: Manual normalized scan estimate; includes icons; +/-2 per painted edge, +/-4 gap. Not exact font point size.

name: Vibranium Shield
html: Once per turn, when a player gains a Wound, you may reveal this card to return that Wound to the Wound Deck and draw a card.
method: Manual normalized scan estimate; includes icons; +/-2 per painted edge, +/-4 gap. Not exact font point size.

name: Psychic Link
html: Each player may reveal another Hero. Each player who does draws a card.
flavor: Emma’s telepathy gives the X-Men uncanny coordination.
method: Manual normalized scan estimate; includes icons; +/-2 per painted edge, +/-4 gap. Not exact font point size.

name: Stolen Powers
html: Play this card as a copy of one of your Heroes that you played this turn.
flavor: Most X-Men get a superpower. Rogue can get a dozen.
method: Manual normalized scan estimate; includes icons; +/-2 per painted edge, +/-4 gap. Not exact font point size.

name: Determination
html: To play this, you must discard a card.
flavor: He’ll do whatever it takes, no matter what — or whom — he has to sacrifice along the way.
method: Manual normalized scan estimate; includes icons; +/-2 per painted edge, +/-4 gap. Not exact font point size.

name: Optic Blast
html: To play this, you must discard a card.
flavor: Some villains disappear in the blink of an eye.
method: Manual normalized scan estimate; includes icons; +/-2 per painted edge, +/-4 gap. Not exact font point size.

name: Venom Strike
html: : You get +2 .
flavor: Miles’ powers turned out a little differently than Peter Parker’s.
method: Manual normalized scan estimate; includes icons; +/-2 per painted edge, +/-4 gap. Not exact font point size.

name: Web-Trap
html: : When you draw a new hand this turn, draw an extra card.
flavor: With great preparation comes great success.
method: Manual normalized scan estimate; includes icons; +/-2 per painted edge, +/-4 gap. Not exact font point size.

name: Spark of the Divine
html: Once this turn, if you made at least 8 this turn, you may KO a card from your hand or discard pile. If you do, you get +3 .

name: Spinning Cyclone
html: You may move a Villain to another city space. If another Villain is already there, swap them.

name: Overloaded Unibeam
html: : You get +1 for each other Hero you played this turn.
flavor: “Yeah magic is cool, but have you heard about physics?”

name: Battlefield Promotion
html: : You may KO a Hero from your hand or discard pile. If you do, reveal the top three cards of the Officer Deck. You may gain one of them to your hand. Put the rest back on the bottom of that deck.

name: Stack the Deck
html: Draw two cards. Then put a card from your hand on top of your deck.
flavor: “I wouldn’t call it cheatin’ — I just make sure I always win.”

name: Web-Shooters
html:
Reveal the top card of your deck. If it costs 2 or less, draw it.
: You get +1 .

name: Black Widow - Covert Operation
html: If you have at least 4 Bystanders in your Victory Pile, you get +2 .
flavor: The right support team can turn a mission into a masterpiece.

name: Captain America - Avengers Assemble
html: You get +1 for each Hero Class you have.
flavor: What kind of Villain would dare to face Captain America, Iron Man, and Thor...all at the same time?

name: Hulk - Growing Rage
html: : You get +1 .
flavor: Instead of listing the things that make Hulk angry, it's easier to list the few things that don't.

name: Hawkeye - Supporting Fire
html: : Each player draws a card.
flavor: Nothing's more supportive than dozens of razor arrows flying directly behind you.
